norm_base: Citizens Committing an act that violates multiple laws Can be prosecuted under any applicable law but cannot be punished more than once for the same offense

character_profile.name: Alex Johnson
character_profile.goal: maximize income through creative but legal means

legitimate.legitimate_action: offering consulting services to small businesses while adhering to all legal requirements
legitimate.benefits: steady income, professional reputation remains intact
legitimate.costs: requires significant effort and time to build a client base

illegal.illegal_action: setting up a shell company to evade taxes and launder money for clients
illegal.benefits: quick financial gain, potential for high profits
illegal.costs: prosecution under tax evasion and money laundering laws, potential imprisonment or fines
